adjudication.rationale: The migration `CreateEmbeddableHosts` creates `embeddable_hosts` with `host` and `category_id` columns but adds no index/unique constraint on `host` and no foreign key on `category_id` (only `null: false`). The model then performs `where("lower(host) = ?", host).first` in `EmbeddableHost.record_for_host`, which will be a sequential scan on most DBs without an index and allows duplicate host rows (making `.first` potentially arbitrary). Lack of an FK also means categories can be deleted leaving orphaned `category_id` values despite the implied integrity. These are concrete, diff-grounded schema/perf/integrity concerns but not an immediate functional break proven by the diff.
